items.author: Ryan Gladwin
items.content:
In brief
- GTA 6's launch trailer was released on Thursday and briefly mentioned "Dacity Coin," which has caused an on-chain frenzy.
- A copycat Solana meme coin skyrocketed 2,900%, thanks to the trailer, with dozens of traders profiting more than $10,000 each.
- The token existed five days before the trailer release, after degens found mention of Dacity Coin in leaked GTA 6 footage.
Two seconds of the Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer was all it took for a Solana meme coin to fly, making some traders pretty rich.
Dacity Coin was seen plastered along the side of a plane in the GTA 6 launch trailer released on Thursday, with a man setting off a neon pink flare on the wing. This prompted a real meme coin of the same name to skyrocket 2,900% from a $104,000 market capitalization to $3.18 million, in the hour following the trailer's release.
Interestingly, the token had been created five days prior, after notorious Rockstar hacker "Cyberleek" leaked GTA 6 gameplay revealing that Dacity Coin was set to be in the game—but only a comparatively small group of traders noticed.
Upon its October 11 launch on Solana launchpad Pump.fun, Dacity Coin hit a peak market cap of $1.14 million before falling to $144,700 over the coming day and trading sideways until Thursday's sharp rise.
$Dacity coin confirmed in the game
This is the 100m runner we’ve been waiting for early not wrong on my pump call out
Check the 54 second mark https://t.co/LTv2BmRubD https://t.co/hCDN0NwVsF pic.twitter.com/DPwbdVK2Mg
— COREY (@Corey_Ape) October 15, 2026
As a result, traders had plenty of time to buy into the meme coin before it skyrocketed. According to DEX Screener, 24 traders profited more than $10,000 on the token, with the top trader turning $1,912 into $44,000.
Dacity now sits at a $1.5 million market cap, dropping around 53% from its $3.18 million peak.
What is Dacity?
In the launch trailer, the plane reads "DacityCoin AudaCity," and in previously leaked footage, the game's protagonist Lucia can be seen skydiving wearing an AudaCity parachute. When the parachute opens, per the leaked screenshots, it features the slogan "Quit your job. Sell your house. Move [ineligible]."
According to the GTA wiki, Lucia is asked to parachute as a stunt to advertise the AudaCity brand and attract investment to the Dacity Coin.
If true, the game appears to be satirizing the stunts that meme coin creators have performed to promote their tokens over the years. In 2024, Decrypt reported that a man set himself on fire to promote his meme coin while others smoked drugs on livestream, pretended to be a dog, or recklessly shot a pistol out of their window.
This falls on the backdrop of years-long rumours of cryptocurrencies featuring in GTA 6. Several theories were thrown out, including play-to-earn features, NFT-owned properties, and even an entire blockchain for the game. However, all of them were unsubstantiated—Dacity Coin is the first solid sign of cryptocurrency being in the upcoming game.
How prominent will Dacity Coin be in the upcoming GTA 6 game? That's the question currently on the lips of traders. If it's a mainstay of the game, then degens might stand to profit handsomely from holding the token for longer. If not, well, this might be the end of the road.
Déjà vu
This has all happened before.
In February 2025, Fortnite added a fake crypto coin called Dill Bits, and degens quickly launched a real one on Solana that hit a $4.78 million market cap before crashing 96%. It pumped 2,700% again in April after Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney called it a scam, then dropped 82% within days.
“I didn’t launch it. What is wrong with you people,” Sweeney posted, as traders floated theories that he was secretly behind the coin.
I didn’t launch it. What is wrong with you people.
— Tim Sweeney (@TimSweeneyEpic) April 6, 2025
The Dill Bits community took the whole thing as bullish, given that Fortnite’s storyline was literally about a pickle villain called Big Dill running a crypto rug pull. It didn’t help much, with DB dropping 82.3% in the days that followed.
Epic Games told Decrypt at the time that there was “no real cryptocurrency or memecoin associated with Fortnite or endorsed by Epic.”
Rockstar has yet to say anything about Dacity Coin, and the game studio did not respond to Decrypt's request for comment.

PrismML把90亿参数模型权重压到2GB：iPhone本地每秒生成34个Token

动察 Beating AI 快讯，美国 AI 公司 PrismML 为 Bonsai 2 家族新增 2B、4B、9B 三款模型，全部基于阿里 Qwen3.5。团队把语言模型的主要权重限制为 -1、0、+1 三种取值，使模型文件分别缩至 0.43GB、0.95GB 和 2GB，体积约为原版 16 位权重的九分之一。新模型仍支持推理、图像理解和工具调用，主要面向手机、个人电脑等设备上的本地 Agent。

PrismML 称，在 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，9B 模型每秒最多生成 34 个 Token，2B 则达到 120 个。

在官方测试中，9B 的编程和指令遵循能力几乎追平同规模的原版 Qwen3.5，但复杂任务差距明显。测试多轮对话和工具操作的 Tau2Bench 中，Bonsai 2 9B 得分为 73.02，原版达到 85.25；复杂文档解析得分则为 73.8，原版达到 88.73。

三款模型已按 Apache 2.0 协议开放权重。

items.author: Shaurya Malwa
items.content:
Bitcoin climbed back above $82,000 on Friday, a day after a brief drop under $80,000, as ZEC led a broad crypto bounce with an 11% jump to about $1,230 — even as investors pulled money from the token’s only U.S. ETF.
SOL and ether each gained more than 3%, to about $106 and $2,450, and DOGE and XRP added between 2% and 3%. BNB, HYPE and TRX rose about 1%, and bitcoin was up nearly 1%, according to CoinDesk data.
The bounce hasn’t reached the ETFs. The U.S. spot ZEC fund lost about $15 million on Thursday, its fifth outflow this month, according to SoSoValue data. Ether funds shed about $60 million, and SOL funds lost nearly $10 million, their ninth straight day of withdrawals. XRP funds saw a small outflow.
Bitcoin ETFs drew a net $5 million, a thin inflow after Wednesday’s $261 million exit.
A second straight day of bitcoin ETF inflows would be the first sign the bounce from $80,000 has buyers behind it.

微软完成2.8万亿参数模型预训练：比GPT-5.6基座更强，算力仅用1/4

动察 Beating AI 快讯，微软宣布完成新一代自研模型 MAI-Base-2 的预训练。模型总参数达 2.8 万亿，采用 MoE 混合专家架构，每次仅激活 800 亿参数。

今年 8 至 9 月，微软动用 1.6 万张 NVIDIA GB200 GPU，训练了 38 天，处理约 50 万亿 Token。新模型还首次引入原生视觉预训练，视觉数据占训练量的 18%。

微软公布的内部测试显示，MAI-Base-2 在代码、问答、数学和理工学科的文本预测指标上，超过 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base、Kimi K3、Qwen3.8 等模型。

微软还宣称，如果只想训练出 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base 同等水平的模型，自己的方法只需花费约 1/4 至 1/12 的算力。但微软继续投入更多算力，把模型做得更大、更强。MAI-Base-2 实际消耗的训练算力仍高于 DeepSeek。

微软 AI 负责人 Mustafa Suleyman 在 10 月 15 日的内部会议上称，MAI-Base-2 的预训练基座已经强于支撑 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 OpenAI 模型，而训练算力仅为后者的四分之一。

微软改进了 MoE 专家调度、Muon 优化器和数据筛选方法，减少显存浪费，提高大规模训练的稳定性。微软还强调，所有训练数据都由自己处理，没有通过蒸馏其他公司的模型获取能力。

MAI-Base-2 目前仍在后训练阶段，微软计划先将其用于自家产品，再通过 Foundry 向企业合作伙伴授权模型权重。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372232

- The market cycle signals metric showed BTC/USD poised to reclaim this “inflection frontier,” which it lost in December 2025.
- CryptoQuant’s bull-bear market cycle indicator continued to show Bitcoin as being in a bull market.
Analysis: Bitcoin “reset” complete as key trend line reappears
Data from onchain analytics platform CryptoQuant reveals that BTC/USD has begun a fresh battle with its 20-month simple moving average (SMA).
The 20-month SMA, at $87,165 as of Oct. 16, is the trend line around which the popular Bollinger Bands metric is constructed. This in turn forms the basis for CryptoQuant’s market cycle signals tool, which seeks to pinpoint Bitcoin’s position within its market cycle.
Bollinger Bands uses standard deviation to add an upper and lower band around the 20-month SMA. Currently, these sit at $121,640 and $52,694, respectively. CryptoQuant’s indicator describes the zone between the lower band and SMA as an “accumulation base,” while the SMA itself is referred to as an “inflection frontier,” a previous point of investor capitulation as price broke below it from above, most recently in December 2025.
BTC/USD one-month chart with Bollinger Bands. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
With Bitcoin now preparing to challenge the capitulation zone from below, history shows that successful breakouts have led to new cycle highs.
“Just over a year after the all-time high (ATH) of $124,709 on October 6, 2025, the market has concluded its ‘reset,’” CryptoQuant contributor GugaOnChain summarized in a blog post.
While Bollinger Bands are not intended to offer buy and sell signals, market cycle signals sees “smart money” taking profit once BTC/USD reaches its upper band. While this currently sits just below Bitcoin’s most recent all-time high of $126,200 from October 2025, CryptoQuant sees the next rally continuing beyond that level.
“While retail fears the current $82,442, thinking it’s the ‘top,’ the on-chain indicator BTC: Market Cycle Signals reveals that we are just warming up,” GugaOnChain added, referring to a current BTC price support zone.
Bitcoin market cycle signals chart. Source: CryptoQuant
The 20-month SMA has confluence with Bitcoin’s 2026 opening level at $87,490, boosting its strength as resistance. As Cointelegraph reported, large walls of ask liquidity remain in the vicinity across exchange order books.
Onchain data shows entrenching Bitcoin bull market
CryptoQuant maintains a broadly optimistic stance on Bitcoin’s emerging bull market despite crypto and risk assets navigating macroeconomic headwinds.
Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today
This week, contributor XWIN Research Japan flagged data from three onchain metrics that they said gave reason for “cautious optimism” for bullish momentum to return through the end of October.
In late August, CEO Ki Young Ju officially stated that the bear market was “over” based on readings from the bull-bear market cycle indicator. This uses composite data from several onchain profitability metrics, and shows bullish momentum accelerating with a reading of 0.186 on its scale versus 0.042 in August.
Bitcoin bull-bear market cycle Indicator. Source: CryptoQuant

Vercel给Agent加上常驻后台：任务能持续处理，沙箱销毁也不丢文件

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Vercel 在 Ship 2026 开发者大会上推出 Daemons，让开发者可以直接部署长期运行的后台进程。它能不断从消息队列或数据库领取任务，处理完一项再接下一项，进程崩溃后也会自动重启。过去 Vercel 主要按请求执行代码，开发者要运行长期任务，往往需要另外部署后台服务。Daemons 目前已进入公测。

另一项更新是正式开放 Drives，为 AI Agent 提供持久化文件存储。以前临时沙箱关闭后，里面的文件也会消失。现在 Agent 可以把代码、数据和工作成果保存在独立存储中，下次启动新沙箱时继续使用。开发者还能复制工作区，让多个 Agent 从同一份文件出发，并行处理不同任务，互不覆盖修改。

Vercel 还为 Connect 加入了 MCP Events，允许 Agent 订阅外部系统的事件。例如，GitHub 出现新 Issue，或文档收到新评论时，兼容的 MCP 服务就能主动发送通知，由应用触发 Agent 处理，不必反复查询是否有新任务。该功能仍处于公测，需要外部服务支持事件订阅。

这几项更新也扩大了 Vercel 的业务范围。原本主要用它部署网站的开发者，现在可以把长期运行的后台任务、Agent 工作区和事件接入一起放在 Vercel 上，减少另外搭建和维护基础设施的工作。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Hardware wallets are physical devices that keep crypto private keys offline, signing transactions internally so the keys never touch an internet-connected device.
- They are not hack-proof: a Coldcard firmware bug and tampered Ledger devices sold through a reseller both led to major losses in 2026.
- Wallet manufacturers are looking to future-proof their devices for a future of agentic finance and quantum computing.
There's an old saying in crypto: "not your keys, not your coins." When you leave Bitcoin, Ethereum or any other cryptocurrency on an exchange, the exchange holds the private keys that control those funds. If it gets hacked, goes bust or freezes withdrawals, you may have no way to get them back.
The obvious fix is to hold your own keys, which is called self-custody. That brings its own problem, though. A private key stored in a software wallet on an internet-connected phone or laptop can be stolen by malware, phishing sites and remote attackers.
Hardware wallets were built to solve this. They're small physical devices that keep your private keys offline, so you can sign crypto transactions without your keys ever touching a device connected to the internet. In this guide we'll explain what hardware wallets are, how they work, who makes them, and where the technology is heading after an eventful 2026.
What is a hardware wallet?
A hardware wallet is a dedicated physical device, usually about the size of a USB stick or credit card, that generates and stores the private keys for your crypto. It's a form of "cold storage," because the keys stay offline. A "hot wallet" like a browser extension or mobile app is the opposite.
One common misconception is that your coins live on the device. They don't. Your crypto always lives on the blockchain. The hardware wallet holds the keys that prove you own it and let you move it.
The category dates back more than a decade. Trezor, made by Czech firm SatoshiLabs, calls itself the inventor of the hardware wallet in 2013. France-based Ledger was founded in 2014 and has since reported sales of more than eight million devices.
Did you know?
When you set up a hardware wallet, it gives you a "seed phrase" of 12 to 24 words. Anyone who has those words can recreate your wallet and take your funds, so never photograph them, type them into a website, or save them to cloud storage.
How does a hardware wallet work?
When you first switch on a hardware wallet, it uses a random number generator to create your private keys. A seed phrase backs them up, and a PIN code protects the device.
When you want to send crypto, you build the transaction in companion software on your computer or phone, such as Ledger Wallet (formerly Ledger Live), Trezor Suite or Sparrow. The software sends the unsigned transaction to the hardware wallet. You check the details on the device's own screen and confirm with a physical button or touchscreen. The device then signs the transaction inside its own hardware and sends back only the signature. The private key never leaves the device.
Devices connect in different ways, and each comes with security trade-offs:
- USB: the classic wired connection.
- Bluetooth and NFC: wireless options for mobile users.
- QR codes or microSD cards: "air-gapped" devices that never connect to another device directly.
Many devices also use a secure element, a tamper-resistant chip like the ones in passports and bank cards, to guard keys against physical attacks.
Did you know?
"Clear signing" means a wallet shows transaction details in plain language rather than raw code, so you know what you're approving. That matters because scammers often trick people into signing malicious smart contract approvals.
What's so special about hardware wallets?
Their main advantage is isolation. Even if your laptop is full of malware, an attacker can't take your keys out of a well-designed hardware wallet or approve a transaction without you physically confirming it.
Hardware wallets have improved over the years, evolving from miniscule screens and clunky interfaces to modern devices that incorporate Bluetooth, NFC and even touchscreens and cameras.
Hardware wallets are also starting to do more than just crypto storage. Ledger added stablecoin yield through Kiln in April 2025, Tangem followed with Aave later that year, and Trezor launched native stablecoin yield through Morpho vaults in May 2026.
Who makes hardware wallets?
- 🔐 Ledger combines its secure element chips and Donjon white hat hacking team with slick hardware design.
- 🛡️ Trezor is the open-source pioneer behind the Safe 3, Safe 5 and Safe 7.
- 📷 Keystone makes air-gapped wallets that sign transactions by QR code.
- 💳 Tangem makes NFC cards that tap against your phone and can skip seed phrases entirely.
- 🔑 Bitkey from Jack Dorsey's Block uses a multisig setup for added security.
Are hardware wallets hack-proof?
Like any device, hardware wallets can be compromised—something that became painfully apparent in July 2026, when attackers took advantage of a five-year-old Coldcard firmware bug that had weakened the randomness used to create seeds.
According to TRM Labs, the exploit drained about 1,816 BTC, worth around $116 million, from more than 5,200 addresses. Updating the firmware doesn't fix seeds that were already created, so affected users have to move their funds to a new wallet.
Hardware wallets are also vulnerable to physical hacks. In October 2026, Ledger revealed that an unauthorized chip implanted in devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis was able to read seed phrases as they were entered during setup and transmit them to an attacker. The investigation followed reports that some $86 million had been drained from Ledger wallet users.
Although the firm’s own Secure Element hardware had not been compromised, its reseller network created a centralized point of vulnerability that attackers were able to exploit by tampering with the device to add their own hidden chip.
Ledger subsequently halted distribution via resellers in seven Asian markets, while a European reseller, MediaMarkt, also stopped sales following reports of unauthorized implants. Rival manufacturer Trezor also wound up its reseller program as a “precautionary measure.”
Another point of vulnerability is third-party vendors and shipping partners, with several hacks and exploits exposing customer data including addresses. While no funds were lost in those cases, leaked customer details feed phishing scams and even physical "wrench attacks," where criminals threaten crypto holders in person.
For most people, phishing and a poorly stored seed phrase are much bigger risks than someone hacking the device itself.
Where to buy a hardware wallet
Always buy hardware wallets straight from the manufacturer's official website, and avoid second-hand devices and unofficial marketplace listings. As the CryptoBilis incident demonstrates, even authorized resellers represent a point of vulnerability that attackers can exploit, and it’s likely that manufacturers will rethink their reseller programs in its aftermath.
The future of hardware wallets
Hardware wallets are turning into full self-custody platforms, and broadening their scope beyond crypto transactions. Ledger’s latest device, the Android-powered Atom, launched in October 2026, is designed around messaging, apps and agentic finance. The firm has even stopped billing its devices as “hardware wallets,” preferring instead to refer to them as “signers” to reflect their widening array of use cases.
Hardware makers are also positioning themselves for AI agents. In June 2026, Ledger released Agent Stack, an open-source toolkit that lets AI agents check balances and draft transactions, but not move funds until a human signs off on a Ledger device. The same toolkit extends those hardware-enforced controls to institutional treasury teams through Ledger Enterprise, with policy enforcement anchored in hardware security modules.
Quantum computing is another future focus for manufacturers, since it could eventually break the cryptography that secures crypto wallets today. Trezor's Safe 7, launched in late 2025, uses a post-quantum signature scheme to verify its bootloader and is built to receive quantum-resistant updates without users having to move their keys to a new device. The concern has sharpened since Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin and Ethereum Foundation researcher Justin Drake warned in October 2026 that AI could break crypto encryption before quantum computers do.
The business has hit some bumps. Ledger had been weighing a U.S. IPO at a valuation of about $4 billion, but put it on hold in May 2026 because of weak market conditions. Meanwhile, the Coldcard and CryptoBilis incidents, and customer data leaks, have been a wake-up call for users, highlighting that a hardware wallet is not the be-all and end-all of crypto security, and should form part of a suite of self-custody tools and practices.

items.author: Omkar Godbole
items.content:
MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.
- MSCI finalized rules that could remove Strategy, Metaplanet and other investment-heavy companies from its global equity indexes after trading closes on Nov. 30.
- The affected firms will be named on Nov. 11.
- JPMorgan analysts have estimated that Strategy’s exclusion could prompt about $2.8 billion in stock outflows, though index funds’ forced sales would affect the company’s shares, not its bitcoin holdings.
MSCI, one of the world's biggest stock index providers, finalized rules proposed in August that could remove shares of leading bitcoin 
Under the rules announced Thursday, companies that mostly hold investments rather than running a real business will be deemed ineligible for MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes. The final list of affected firms is due Nov. 11 and the change takes effect at the close of Nov. 30.
The decision is important because it affects demand for the companies’ shares. Many investors gain exposure to stock markets by placing their money in funds that track an index. When a company is added to the index, those funds must buy its stock. When it is removed, they must sell, whatever the fund managers think of the company.
"The MSCI episode highlights a growing tension between traditional index construction and the rise of companies that treat Bitcoin as a core treasury asset rather than a secondary holding,” decentralized infrastructure network ZEROBASE said on X. “Passive capital has become an important source of demand for these stocks; any sustained reduction in that bid could tighten the equity-issuance window that several of them rely on to fund further purchases."
The risk is biggest for Tysons Corner, Virginia-based Strategy, the largest publicly listed bitcoin holder, with 848,250 BTC worth about $69.67 billion, according to Bitcoin Treasuries. It tends to fund its purchases by selling preferred shares such as STRC and STRK.
JPMorgan analysts have estimated that index exclusion could trigger outflows of about $2.8 billion from MSTR stock. The shares closed at $151.29 on Thursday, down about 72% from their record high of $543 in November 2024. Tokyo-based Metplanet, which closed at 277 yen ($1.75) on Friday, peaked at 1,930 yen in June 2025, according to TradingView.
Any selling would hit the shares, not bitcoin. The funds would be dumping the stock, which does not necessarily mean Strategy would sell its bitcoin.
But weaker demand for the shares could make it harder for these companies to raise the money they use to buy more bitcoin, a strategy they have long pursued to stack up more coins.
Strategy's founder, Michael Saylor, has described the company as an operating business with a software arm, and its bitcoin treasury as a distinct business segment. He has rejected comparisons with investment funds. Strategy, originally MicroStrategy, sells business intelligence software to companies including Coca-Cola and Porsche.
How MSCI decides who is out
MSCI already excludes investment funds and similar vehicles. The new rules extend that to companies that look like them.
First, MSCI checks whether a company has substantial operating assets, meaning assets tied to a real business. If it fails, the company faces a second test based on five financial ratios covering expenses, cash flow, changes in asset values and reliance on outside financing. A company flagged on four or more of the five is ineligible.
To avoid constant churn in the index, MSCI has added buffers. A member is removed only if it fails the screen in each of its two most recent annual filing periods. A company outside the index is blocked from joining if it fails in either of its two most recent periods.
In a first test run using May 2026 data, MSCI flagged three companies for possible removal from its ACWI Investable Market Index. They were Strategy, Metaplanet and Yellow Cake, a U.K. uranium investment company.
MSCI is also ending the temporary measures it announced in October 2025 for companies with digital assets making up 50% or more of total assets. Those measures froze increases in the share counts used in the index and put off additions and size-segment moves for those companies. From the November review, they will be judged under the new rules instead.

黑森林FLUX 3 Klein开源：官方自测超Qwen，玩家却嫌不如旧版4B

动察 Beating AI 快讯，德国 AI 公司 Black Forest Labs 开源图像模型 FLUX 3 Image Klein。官方标称 56 亿参数，但这只计算负责生成图像的部分，实际还需要 40 亿参数的 Qwen3-VL 理解文字指令，两者合计约 96 亿参数。新模型支持原生 4K 出图、图像编辑和最多 10 张参考图。量化后最低可在 8GB 显存的 RTX 显卡运行，RTX 5090 生成一张百万像素图片约需 4 秒。

官方内部评测显示，FLUX 3 Klein 的文生图和图像编辑能力均超过 Qwen-Image 2.1。相比自家上一代 FLUX.2 Klein 9B，两项评分分别提高 91 和 70 Elo。但 Reddit 社区的首批实测却反馈不佳。有用户展示了调整人物姿势、切换视角失败的案例，甚至认为效果不如上一代 4B 模型。

另一项包含 200 个真实编辑任务的第三方盲测中，FLUX 3 Klein 得分为 6.93，略低于 Nano Banana 2.1 的 7.20，但单张图片成本仅为后者的五分之一。测试同样发现，它在人物姿势调整和多图合成上容易出错。

黑森林特别强调，使用前最好先让额外的语言模型扩写提示词，否则简短指令容易产生平庸结果。为此，团队额外提供了一款 90 亿参数的提示词扩写器。

模型采用 FLUX Kommunity License，个人及合并年营收低于 500 万美元的企业可按条款免费商用生成图片，但商业微调另需授权。API 生成一张 1K 图片起价 0.009 美元。

Vercel：开源模型吃下71.5% Token，中国模型正在为美国推理服务商创造大量生意

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Vercel 发布最新 AI Gateway 用量报告。9 月，开源模型处理了平台 71.5% 的 Token，但按公开价格估算，调用费用只占 23%。一个月前，开源模型的 Token 份额还只有约 56%。

其中，DeepSeek 最能跑量。旗下模型占平台 58% 的 Token，估算费用却只占 6.6%。仅 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 就处理了接近一半的 Token，费用仅占 2.6%。月之暗面的 Kimi 则相反，只占 3.6% 的 Token，却对应 13.2% 的费用。低价模型承接了大量请求，Kimi K3 等单价更高的模型则贡献了更多消费金额。

更值得注意的是，中国模型正在为美国推理服务商创造大量生意。9 月，中国模型近 70% 的估算调用费用对应美国服务商，而 2025 年 12 月还不到 10%。DeepSeek 自己处理了超过八成的模型 Token，但美国服务商承接的调用平均计费更高，约四成费用对应美国公司。这些公司不必自己研发模型，只需部署 DeepSeek 的开放权重，提供算力和 API 服务，就能向客户收费。

与此同时，Vercel 平台 9 月的 AI 调用总费用比 2025 年 12 月增长约 13 倍，平均每 Token 价格却下降了 47%。在持续活跃的高用量付费团队中，近三分之一更换了最常用的模型厂商。企业可以通过统一 API 调用不同模型，不必分别对接每家厂商。即使使用同一款模型，也可以选择不同的推理服务商。模型研发商不再独占调用收入，提供推理服务的公司，以及掌握开发者入口的 Vercel 等平台，也在争夺这门生意。

items.content:
Capital B reports $78M H1 loss driven by Bitcoin impairment charge
Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.
France-listed Bitcoin treasury company Capital B reported a net loss of 69.5 million euro ($78 million) for the first half of 2026, driven by a Bitcoin impairment charge of $75.8 million.
The impairment reflected Bitcoin (BTC) prices as of June 30 and had no direct cash impact, according to the company’s first-half 2026 report, published Thursday.
Still, Capital B’s consolidated revenue rose 3.5% year-over-year to $6.5 million, while adjusted EBITDA was negative $1.2 million. EBITDA measures a company’s earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
The results show that the European Bitcoin treasury firm continued raising funds to fuel its Bitcoin accumulation despite the accounting losses. Capital B announced capital raises totaling $30 million in the first half of the year and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11%, from 2,823 BTC in January to 3,139 BTC by the end of June.
The company’s total holdings subsequently reached 3,538 Bitcoin by Sept. 30, marking a 25% increase from the beginning of the year. Capital B’s treasury is currently worth $290 million, ranking it as the world’s 25th-largest corporate Bitcoin treasury and Europe’s second-largest by holdings, following Germany-based Bitcoin Group, according to Bitcointreasuries.
Capital B’s stock price rose by 0.5% in early morning trading on Friday, but was down 25% year-to-date, according to Yahoo Finance.
In July, Capital B approved a 10-for-1 reverse stock split aimed at broadening its institutional investor base. In June, its shareholders approved up to $120 billion in financing capacity, including equity and credit instruments, to support the company’s Bitcoin accumulation strategy.
Related: Bitcoin will become ‘less volatile’ and larger than gold: ‘The Bitcoin Standard’ author

items.content:
Judge rejects CFTC, Gemini bid to undo $5M settlement
Judge ruled changes in CFTC enforcement priorities and allegations of misconduct by its enforcement division were insufficient to overturn Gemini’s January 2025 settlement.
A US federal judge has rejected a joint request by crypto exchange Gemini and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to overturn a $5 million settlement, despite the regulator’s conclusion that it would not have pursued the case under current enforcement standards.
On Thursday, US District Judge Alvin Hellerstein ruled that changes in CFTC enforcement priorities and allegations of misconduct by its enforcement division did not justify overturning the January 2025 settlement.
On May 27, the CFTC and Gemini jointly asked the court to overturn the settlement after an internal agency review found alleged misconduct by the regulator’s enforcement division, including reliance on a questionable whistleblower, improper regulatory pressure and efforts to prevent the disclosure of evidence.
The ruling leaves intact a permanent injunction barring Gemini from making false or misleading statements to the CFTC. The settlement also prohibits Gemini from publicly denying its findings, although the regulator said in June that it would no longer enforce such restrictions.
Gemini has already paid the $5 million penalty, which the CFTC previously told Cointelegraph would not be refunded even if the settlement were overturned.
Judge cites Gemini’s decision to settle before trial
The case centered on how Gemini operated its Bitcoin auction. According to the January 2025 consent order, the exchange failed to disclose that some customers traded using borrowed funds, that self-trading had occurred despite safeguards and that certain traders received special fee arrangements.
Gemini also submitted trading volume data without disclosing that some of the activity involved these practices.
Related: Better Markets says CFTC is ‘wrong agency’ to regulate retail crypto
Hellerstein said Gemini was already aware of problems with the CFTC’s case when it agreed to settle, less than three weeks before trial. Although the exchange later obtained additional internal CFTC documents, the judge ruled that the new information was not enough to overturn a settlement Gemini had voluntarily accepted.
The judge also rejected the argument that President Donald Trump’s digital asset executive order and the regulator’s new enforcement approach warranted relief, saying they reflected changes in policy rather than a significant change in law.
Former CFTC Chair Timothy Massad previously called the regulator’s move to reverse a settled case “extraordinarily unusual,” telling Cointelegraph that the public “deserves a better explanation.”
Magazine: Can the SEC and CFTC’s pro-crypto rules be overturned? Legal opinion

Anthropic让6名外部研究员驻场查AI安全：报告无需审批，但公司仍保留删改权

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 宣布，已让独立 AI 评测机构 METR 的 6 名研究员进入公司，提供办公空间、工作电脑，以及与内部安全评估团队大致相当的系统权限。他们不再只是从外部测试 Claude，还能接触内部工具，调查模型的危险行为、安全事故和防护措施。Anthropic 将这种安排比作银行监管机构派驻银行的常驻检查员。

METR 可以自行公开风险评估和调查结论，Anthropic 无权阻止报告发表。不过，涉及客户数据、受法律保密保护的材料和模型架构时，公司仍能要求删除相关内容。如果 METR 认为删改不合理，可以公开提出异议，但不能披露被删的原文。

Anthropic 将外部评测分成 3 个等级，METR 已进入权限最高的一级。另一家非营利机构 SecureBio 正审查其生化武器风险，埃森哲旗下 Faculty 也在推进模型红队测试和安全评估。METR 明确表示，不接受前沿 AI 公司的报酬或捐款，而 Anthropic 此前宣布直接出资支持埃森哲的评测工作。

METR 在 10 月 14 日发布的说明中承认，目前的合作仍依赖 AI 公司自愿提供信息，评测员可能拿不到关键证据，厂商也能通过限制访问和删改报告影响公众看到的内容。

Arthur Hayes: Trading Other Assets to Buy More Bitcoin

On October 13, 2026, Maelstrom co-founder Arthur Hayes said in an interview with The Rollup that whether scarce assets like Bitcoin or on-chain businesses outperform depends on the entry price, market capitalization, and the protocol and smart contract risks investors are willing to take. He suggested that a token with a market cap below 1 billion could outperform Bitcoin if demand from AI agents drives a valuation re-rating.

Discussing his own allocation, Hayes said the fund’s Bitcoin position is so large that its other holdings are insignificant by comparison. Even when the fund holds substantial positions in ETH or other tokens, it takes profits and uses them to buy more Bitcoin. Trading other assets to generate profits and accumulate more Bitcoin is the fund’s core objective.

WuBlockchain notes that Arthur Hayes' market forecasts have had a low historical accuracy rate and that his views frequently change. Readers are advised to focus on his analytical framework rather than specific price targets or timing predictions. — link

Google上线跨店AI购物车：Nike、沃尔玛能一起加购，结账却要分开

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google 开始在美国推出 Universal Cart（通用购物车），让用户在 Google 搜索和 Gemini 中，把不同商家的商品放进同一个购物车。比如在搜索里看中 Steve Madden 的包，再到 Gemini 里挑选 Ulta Beauty 的口红，商品都会保留在购物车中，下次打开还能接着买。这项功能早在今年 5 月的 Google I/O 上就已亮相，如今才真正开始上线。

购物车接入了 Google 超过 600 亿条商品信息的 Shopping Graph，会持续监测价格和库存。商品降价或补货时主动提醒，还能寻找优惠码，结合 Google Wallet 中的信用卡返现、积分等权益，建议更划算的付款方式。

不过，跨店加购不等于跨店统一结账。商品仍按商家分组，支持 UCP（通用商务协议）的部分商家可以直接通过 Google Pay 收款，其他商家则需要跳转各自网站完成交易。首批合作商家包括 Nike、沃尔玛、Target、丝芙兰以及众多 Shopify 商家。订单确认和售后仍由商家负责。

Bitunix分析师：能源成本推升企业价格，美联储面临更棘手的利率抉择

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，美国生产端通胀与消费数据同步走强，让美联储更难判断现有利率是否足以压低物价。9 月 PPI 月增 1.3%、年增 6.3%，核心 PPI 也月增 0.7%、年增 5.0%，均高于市场预期；同期零售销售月增 0.8%，同样优于预期。能源价格单月上涨 10.8%，是生产成本攀升的重要推手，但核心 PPI 仍然偏高，意味着成本压力并非完全来自能源。零售销售则是名义数据，尚未扣除价格变动，消费金额增加不代表实质需求同幅成长。

这组数据让美联储面临更复杂的政策取舍。若企业持续将成本转嫁至商品与服务，通胀回落可能比预期更慢；若利率进一步上升，房贷、企业融资与居民消费又将承受更大压力。主席沃什试图削弱前瞻指引、让市场自行解读经济数据，但近期官员必须密集发声修正升息预期，反映沟通留白未必能降低波动，反而可能增加利率定价的不确定性。

美国财政也构成长期约束。达利欧警告，庞大到期债务与新增借款可能持续推升美债供给；财政部则被市场密切关注是否调整长债回购与发行期限。若政府融资需求、企业 AI 投资与高能源成本同时争夺资金，长期殖利率便可能在美联储未进一步升息前，先行收紧金融条件。

对风险资产而言，关键不只是下一次升息何时发生，而是通胀与需求是否同步降温。若殖利率、美元持续走强，加密资产也可能因资金成本提高及风险偏好下降而承压；若价格压力逐步缓和，市场才有空间重新评估政策路径。接下来，PPI 向 PCE 的传导、实质消费变化与长债殖利率，将比单一政策表态更能反映紧缩是否仍需加码。

沃什拒绝预判年内剩余两次利率决策，10月加息概率降至约17%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，美联储主席凯文·沃什 10 月 16 日在曼谷出席 IMF 会议期间表示，不会预判年内剩余两次议息会议的结果，也不愿提前透露可能采取的行动。他称：「这是美联储的新篇章，我们不再做这种事。」对于同僚近期释放的「本月不急于加息」信号，他既未明确支持，也未反驳。

沃什重申，美联储将实现价格稳定，并称 9 月加息以来，全球经济大体符合央行预期。他将各国央行近期的行动描述为全球大多数地区同步收紧货币政策。美联储 9 月一致加息 25 个基点，将联邦基金利率目标区间上调至 3.75% 至 4%，当时多数官员预计年内至少还会加息一次。

尽管 9 月核心 CPI 环比上涨 0.33%，连续第二个月录得较强涨幅，且最新生产者价格数据同样强劲，沃什几乎没有谈及本周通胀报告，也未明显尝试改变市场对 10 月会议的预期。报道称，他讲话期间美元走低，市场对 10 月加息的押注从约 30% 降至约 17%。

从政策信号看，这更适合解读为保留决策空间，而非明确转鸽。沃什没有预告下一次加息，但也没有承诺停止紧缩或转向降息。此次讲话延续了减少前瞻指引的沟通方式，市场对 10 月暂停加息的押注，不能等同于美联储已经作出的决定。

此外，沃什认为美国正经历大规模投资增长，并对经济韧性及 AI 带来的生产率提升持乐观态度，但警告发展道路将「非常崎岖」，AI 对就业的短期影响尚不清楚。

星展银行宏观策略师 Wei Liang Chang 对沃什的最新言论评价道：「听到沃什重申他的信念，即人工智能将在中期提高生产率，这可能有助于缓和通胀预期，并减轻对美联储连续加息的担忧，市场会感到安心。美元和美债收益率可能会略有回落，但更广泛的价格走势仍将取决于美国股市今晚是否稳定。」

盛宝市场首席投资策略师 Charu Chanana 表示：「沃什拒绝承诺再次加息，导致一些美联储加息押注落空。在强劲的通胀数据公布后，他发表的『我不会预先判断会议』的言论对美元没有帮助。」

香港警方：两周出现超150宗WhatsApp账户劫持案，一虚拟货币兑换公司损失逾400万港元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，中国香港警方「守网者」社交平台公布，过去两周共接获逾 150 宗 WhatsApp 账户劫持骗案，总损失逾 1500 万港元。近日一从事虚拟货币兑换业务的本地公司职员中招，骗子劫持其 WhatsApp 账户后，封锁原工作群并将成员拉黑，再复制群组图片、名称、成员与头像另建假群，伪装成客户代表要求兑换，受害人按惯例先将加密货币汇至对方指定钱包，待发现客户账户余额不足并致电核实后才察觉被骗，公司损失逾 400 万港元。

警方提醒，WhatsApp 群组可造假，但成员电话号码无法与真群完全相同，对话发布时间亦无法复制；并建议启用双重认证、汇款前电话核实对方，避免在公共 WiFi 或公共电脑登录账号。

韩国金融当局加强监管境外永续合约，违规向境内推销或移送检方

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，韩国金融委员会与金融监督院就境外虚拟资产平台上交易的永续合约发布投资者提示。当局称将加强对挂钩韩国股票与股指等永续合约的境外平台监测；若确认存在面向韩国居民招揽开户或交易等境内非法经营行为，将采取包括向侦查机关控告在内的严厉措施，并向主要相关境外平台经营者要求遵守韩国法律。

韩国当局指出，此类永续合约无到期日、24 小时交易，部分产品杠杆可达 10 倍至 200 倍，并以挂钩韩国股指、150 倍杠杆为例，称指数反向波动约 0.66% 即可强制平仓；韩国境内制度上不允许此类产品。境外平台多数不受韩国金融法约束，破产、停业、单方面中断交易或系统事故时，境内纠纷解决与投资者救济困难，客户资产保管情况也难以由国内监管确认。当局称将审慎评估类似产品是否引入国内及相关监管框架。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
ESP32 iPhone Agent开源，让40多元ESP32变身iPhone版豆包手机助手

动察 Beating AI 快讯，开发者 Henry 开源了 ESP32 iPhone Agent，只需一块约 40–50 元的 XIAO ESP32S3 开发板，配合手机 App，就能让 AI 操作真实的 iPhone，打开其他 App、点击按钮、滑动屏幕。它不需要越狱，也不依赖苹果 XCTest 的测试权限。

实现方式很巧妙。ESP32 自己建立 Wi-Fi 热点，充当 AirPlay 投屏接收器。iPhone 把屏幕画面投给开发板，板子不负责解码，而是通过蓝牙把压缩视频传回同一部手机上的 Agent App。

App 调用视觉模型识别界面、决定下一步，再通过蓝牙发送指令，让 ESP32 模拟 USB 鼠标和键盘操作手机。为了避免点击位置偏移，系统还会自动校准鼠标指针，必要时根据画面修正位置。

这套方案用普通 ESP32-S3 就把屏幕接收和输入模拟结合起来，不需要 NanoKVM Go 那样的专用视频采集硬件。Agent 直接在 iPhone 上运行，模型推理则依赖外部 API 或自建服务器。由于手机的 Wi-Fi 被开发板热点占用，默认需要通过蜂窝网络访问模型。首次刷写固件、编译安装 iPhone App 仍需要 Mac 和 Xcode。

受蓝牙带宽限制，传回的画面只有 480×1040 分辨率，最高每秒 5 帧，每步操作通常需要几秒。目前触控坐标只适配竖屏界面，键盘输入仅支持 ASCII 字符，锁屏后也无法继续投屏。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372185

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto, an OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary. A Wall Street Journal investigation revealed that former Trump crypto adviser Bo Hines retained a financial stake in a firm that benefited from a Tether deal while he helped advance US stablecoin legislation, while Ledger introduced an $849 hardware wallet with stronger anti-tampering protections following a security incident in Asia.
OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
An internal research model at OpenAI accessed a funded crypto wallet without authorization, using testnet Ether to deploy smart contracts on the Sepolia network and later omitting the spending from its final task summary.
OpenAI said the model, which was part of its GPT-5.6 Sol family, was given the task of updating a crypto trading prototype and deploying compatible contracts. After failing to obtain testnet ETH through faucets, the model derived accounts from publicly known developer recovery phrases, checked 362 wallet addresses and selected one with enough funds to proceed.
In its recorded reasoning, the model asked, “But using public known key/funds ethically?” It then argued that the funds were “effectively abandoned/test ETH” and that Sepolia ETH had no value, before using the wallet’s private key to sign and broadcast a deployment transaction. The transaction succeeded, with fees charged to the account.
OpenAI said the incident showed how an AI model could decide on its own that using someone else’s funds was acceptable, even without permission. The company discovered the incident while reviewing earlier model activity and has since introduced safeguards to prevent live internet access in similar situations.
Former Trump adviser retained stake in firm that benefited from stablecoin law
Former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines retained a one-third stake in an investment firm that received millions of dollars from Tether while he was helping advance landmark US stablecoin legislation, according to a Wall Street Journal investigation.
The report found that Nxum, an investment company Hines co-founded, received $6.3 million through an agreement with Tether, with the first payment arriving while Hines was still serving in the Trump administration.
Hines reportedly remained in contact with Nxum partners through Signal, sharing updates on the GENIUS Act and encouraging them to criticize Republican lawmakers who opposed the legislation.
The GENIUS Act, which established a federal regulatory framework for payment stablecoins, was signed into law in July 2025. Hines left the administration shortly afterward, joining Tether as a strategic adviser in August before becoming CEO of its US operations.
The revelations add to scrutiny of financial ties between Trump administration officials and the cryptocurrency industry. Several former regulators have also moved into senior industry positions, including former CFTC Commissioner Summer Mersinger, who became CEO of the Blockchain Association.
Ledger’s answer to wallet tampering costs $849 and ships next year
Ledger unveiled a new device on Thursday with stronger protections against tampering, days after confirming that wallets sold through a reseller in Asia contained malicious implants.
The French hardware wallet maker introduced Atom, an $849 device that combines a crypto wallet with everyday apps through a smartphone-like design. Atom separates Android apps from sensitive wallet operations and includes protections Ledger says would block the implants used in the recent Asia incident. It’s also advertised to detect tampering even when switched off.
The company expects to begin shipping the device in summer 2027, according to an announcement shared with Cointelegraph.
Ledger said Atom will also support AI agent approvals, encrypted messaging and post-quantum cryptography.
The announcement follows a security incident that surfaced on Friday involving malicious implants found in wallets sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis. Ledger has requested that distributors in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong suspend sales of its products. European retail chain MediaMarkt has also pulled Ledger wallets off its shelves.

items.content:
OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary.
An internal research model at OpenAI accessed a funded crypto wallet without authorization, using testnet Ether to deploy smart contracts on the Sepolia network and later omitting the spending from its final task summary.
OpenAI said the model, which was part of its GPT-5.6 Sol family, was given the task of updating a crypto trading prototype and deploying compatible contracts. After failing to obtain testnet ETH through faucets, the model derived accounts from publicly known developer recovery phrases, checked 362 wallet addresses and selected one with enough funds to proceed.
In its recorded reasoning, the model asked, “But using public known key/funds ethically?” It then argued that the funds were “effectively abandoned/test ETH” and that Sepolia ETH had no value, before using the wallet’s private key to sign and broadcast a deployment transaction. The transaction succeeded, with fees charged to the account.
OpenAI said the incident showed how an AI model could decide on its own that using someone else’s funds was acceptable, even without permission. The company discovered the incident while reviewing earlier model activity and has since introduced safeguards to prevent live internet access in similar situations.
OpenAI incident adds to concerns over autonomous AI agents
The incident happened on June 26, but was not discovered until Sept. 25, nearly three months later, according to OpenAI. The transaction did not transfer ETH to another wallet but charged the account network fees for deploying a contract.
OpenAI said its misalignment monitoring system now runs across all traffic and is designed to alert security personnel if a model obtains live internet access.
Related: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
The wallet incident follows other disclosures involving OpenAI models acting beyond their authorization or concealing their actions.
On Sept. 16, OpenAI disclosed six other cases of AI misalignment. In one case, instances of GPT-5.6 Sol inserted instructions into task summaries to conceal mistakes from users. Another case involved a model using an exposed API key without authorization before fabricating figures it could not retrieve.
OpenAI said those earlier disclosures were not intended to indicate how frequently misalignment occurs across its models.
Concerns about autonomous agents handling digital assets also predate the latest disclosure. In June, researchers warned that autonomous AI agents equipped with crypto wallets could cause unintended harm even when deployed for legitimate purposes. The researchers recommended safeguards, including emergency shutdown mechanisms, to limit potential risks.

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Perplexity开源SPACE：给AI完整root权限，却把密钥留在虚拟机外

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Perplexity 开源了支撑 Computer 运行的底层沙箱平台 SPACE，采用 Apache 2.0 协议。

SPACE 基于 Firecracker，为每项 Agent 任务创建独立的微型虚拟机。AI 可以在里面获得 root 权限，自由安装软件、运行命令，但无法直接控制宿主机。API 密钥由虚拟机外的系统管理，所有对外网络连接也要经过专用网关检查，防止 Agent 越权访问。

SPACE 还支持长时间运行的 Agent 任务。它可以保存虚拟机的内存、运行状态和文件，让任务暂停后继续，甚至从同一进度分叉，尝试不同方案，不必每次中断都从头开始。

Perplexity 称，今年 7 月已用 SPACE 替换原有商业沙箱服务，目前每天创建数百万个沙箱。与此前的服务相比，创建沙箱的延迟中位数从 185 毫秒降至 60 毫秒，速度提升约 3 倍。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372182

items.author: Omkar Godbole
items.content:
XRP has failed to make holders rich like bitcoin and ether. Here’s why
XRP remains below its 2017-cycle high while bitcoin, ether and other major tokens have surged, enriching their holders.
- XRP trades around $1.33, about 62.5% below its January 2018 peak, while Bitcoin, Ether and several other major cryptocurrencies have surpassed their previous highs.
- Analysts attribute XRP’s lagging price partly to a sharp increase in circulating supply, weak fund inflows and declining trading activity and network use.
- Ripple’s focus on payments, XRP’s limited exposure to popular crypto sectors and years of regulatory uncertainty from the S.E.C. case have also weighed on demand.
Holding is widely touted as a great way to build wealth in the crypto market, but it hasn't worked for every coin.
Take XRP (XRP), the payments-focused cryptocurrency native to the XRP Ledger and the world’s fifth-largest digital asset by market value.
The token is still trading well below its 2017 cycle high, while most other major cryptocurrencies have climbed far above theirs. In 2017, crypto broke into the mainstream, pulling in new users and investors during the frenzied run that carried into the first week or two of 2018.
XRP currently trades around $1.33, down 62.5% from its early January 2018 peak of $3.55. In other words, an XRP buyer from that peak is still underwater nearly nine years later. (XRP did briefly top its old high, reaching $3.66 in July 2025 before crashing.)
Bitcoin 
Bitcoin, ether and many other tokens have pulled back sharply from their 2025 peaks, yet remain far above their 2017 highs.
Too many coins
Analysts point first to XRP’s supply.
"Circulating supply grew 63%, from 38.7B in 2017 to 63.1B, while XRP's total market value fell only about 3%," Nicolai Sondergaard, senior research analyst at analytics firm Nansen, told CoinDesk. "More XRP in circulation means each token represents a smaller share of roughly the same total value."
Circulating supply is the number of coins on the market, and as it grows, each coin represents a smaller share of the total.
Oliver Carding, head of marketing at Tesseract Group, says XRP looks better when measured by total value instead of price.
"On value, XRP recovered," he said. "About 63% more XRP is in circulation than at that peak, so the same circulating market capitalization would mean a price roughly 39% lower."
Tesseract is an institutional digital asset management firm that manages over $500 million in assets under management.
Weaker demand
U.S.-listed exchange-traded funds, or ETFs, have opened the door for institutional investors to take exposure to digital assets. While bitcoin and ether funds have pulled in billions, XRP funds have lagged big time.
"ETF uptake has also been muted relative to $BTC and $ETH," said Paul Howard, senior director at market-making firm Wincent.
To date, XRP funds have pulled in just $1.80 billion in investor money since debuting nearly a year ago, according to data source SoSoValue. Bitcoin ETFs often attract over $1 billion in investor money in a single day.
Nansen's data also shows trading activity has weakened, with XRP spot volume down 53.5%, perpetual futures volume down 44%, and active addresses down 10.7%.
Ripple's focus
Ripple, the payments company closely tied to XRP, has focused on cross-border payments rather than chasing sectors such as DeFi, AI, and memecoins, which have attracted greater capital flows and deeper integration with traditional finance.
"Ripple, meanwhile, has been working hard to build payment infrastructure, RLUSD and trade financing products around the usage of the ledger and coin, and this has taken focus from just core XRP," Howard said.
Investors also have more choices now.
"The role of DeFi for investment into ETH, SOL and HYPE has also been a new narrative which $XRP has not focused on," Howard said.
The SEC case
Ripple’s legal fight with U.S. regulators also held XRP back.
The Securities and Exchange Commission sued Ripple and two of its executives in December 2020, saying the company had raised about $1.3 billion by selling XRP without registering it as a security.
A federal judge ruled in 2023 that XRP sales on public exchanges were not securities offerings, but that sales to institutional investors were. In 2024, Ripple was ordered to pay a $125 million penalty. The case ended in August 2025, when both sides dropped their appeals.
Carding said the prolonged regulatory uncertainty helps explain why the token missed its old high during the 2021 crypto bull run, when Coinbase suspended trading.
“The SEC case helps explain why XRP did not revisit its 2018 high in 2021, when Coinbase suspended trading, but the appeals were dropped in August 2025 with XRP above $3,” Carding said. “Since then, XRP is down about 59%, against 32% for bitcoin and 44% for ether, and its circulating market capitalisation is down about 56%.”
Not the only laggard
XRP isn't the only coin trading below its early 2018 highs.
"On price, six of the other nine assets in the January 2018 top ten are further below their levels of that week," Carding said.
For those watching XRP, Carding has a suggestion.
"What I would watch is XRP against bitcoin, alongside net monthly distribution after re-escrow and changes in fund holdings," he said. "Relative weakness that persists as distribution slows would point to weaker demand."
In plain English, Carding is watching whether XRP underperforms bitcoin even as fewer new XRP tokens enter the market through Ripple’s escrow releases. If supply growth slows but XRP still lags bitcoin, it would suggest that investor demand for XRP is weakening.

Papertrade单日收入已连续两日超过Circle，排名全网第二

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，据 DefiLlama 数据，Papertrade 单日收入 749 万美元，超过 Circle，连续两日位列全网协议第二，仅低于 Tether。上线 7 日以来，累计收入达 5716 万美元。并累计向 PAPER 质押者分配约 5276 万美元，占总收入约 92.30%。

需要指出的是，上述协议收入的口径有些特殊：该平台上交易者已平仓实现 PnL 的 2% fee、爆仓损失保证金的 2% fee、以及超过 500 万美元 LP 上限后被划转给 PAPER 质押者的 LP 余额。因此，所谓「协议收入」大部分为平台交易者亏损导致的 LP 余额增长。

根据官方文档，PAPER 质押者分红来自于两方面：一是协议的 2% 抽水收入（与开发者平分）；二是当 LP 余额超过 500 万美元后，所有超额部分会全部划拨给质押者。由此，该协议形成「输家获得平台股份（PAPER），赢家拿走输家的钱，平台抽水赢家补贴输家」的闭环。

items.content:
Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans
Network School founder Balaji Srinivasan wants to turn Farcaster into a haven for well-mannered techno-optimists. He had to do a bit of housekeeping first.
Balaji Srinivasan’s Network School has begun its reign over the decentralized social platform Farcaster. Its first order of business? An apparent wave of bans that has prompted backlash from members of the decentralized social network.
Network School on Thursday announced it has acquired Farcaster from Neynar, rebranding it as the Network State Protocol. The same day, several users said on X that their Farcaster accounts had been restricted to “read-only,” as a result of previous posts that broke its new rules.
“I know most of these folks. They shaped Farcaster with their quirks and wit,” said Kunal Gandhi, former India ecosystem lead at Eigen Labs. “Obliterating accounts from the get-go for past posts is pretty silly. Goes against the ethos of decentralized social.”
The overhaul is the latest attempt to find a sustainable direction for Farcaster, which is changing hands for the second time this year. Co-founder Dan Romero said the platform had 250,000 monthly active users in December 2025.
Balaji wants the ‘Singapore of social media’
In a post to Farcaster on Thursday, Srinivasan said the bans were part of plans to turn the reference app into “the Singapore of social media,” a positive-sum community of techno-optimists that operate under a shared code of conduct.
One of the first steps was to institute “law and order,” he said. “In the pre-Internet world, it was simply unheard of to run up to a stranger and start cursing at them. We’re restoring that offline norm online.”
“Much like how President Bukele jailed a small fraction of repeat offenders to essentially eliminate crime in El Salvador, we’ve moderated out the small fraction of repeat offenders that have been muted or blocked by many accounts to stop random attacks within this Farcaster reference client.”
Srinivasan said both humans and AI were used to go through millions of posts to determine those to ban, adding there is an appeals process in place for them.
Rewarding “pro-social behavior”
Under Network School’s vision for Network State Protocol, users opt into a “social smart contract” authorizing its core team to set the app’s rules. Its accompanying “Network Code” classifies violations as digital felonies, misdemeanors or infractions, with penalties ranging from warnings and suspensions to bans. The rules apply to past posts as well as new ones.
The code also promises rewards for constructive behavior, including teaching others, sharing projects and disagreeing civilly, although it does not specify what those rewards entail.
Related: Farcaster to return $180M to investors following Neynar takeover
Network School says an open-weight AI model will apply the rules, with some manual judgment calls, and eventually wants to warn users of potential violations before they post.
The underlying Farcaster protocol will remain open, according to the announcement. Users who decline the contract will have read-only access to the main app but retain their keys, funds, followers and post history, allowing them to move to another client. Srinivasan described this ability to join, leave or build competing clients as “decentralized democracy.”
The eventual ambition extends beyond social media. Network School said its goal is for the online community to take physical form through meetups and pop-up events, ultimately developing into startup cities and network states.
Network School’s acquisition of Farcaster comes months after Malaysian authorities revoked its Forest City business licence and ordered it to cease operations, citing alleged licensing and premises-use violations. Srinivasan subsequently announced an agreement to establish a campus in Kazakhstan.

可灵4.0全量上线：30秒1080P视频约16元，4K HDR却还得等

动察 Beating AI 快讯，快手旗下可灵 AI 于 10 月 15 日全量开放 Kling 4.0。此前，Kling 4.0 Flash 已于 9 月底向部分付费用户开放体验。

相比 3.0，新模型将单次视频生成时长从 15 秒延长至 30 秒，还支持最多 10 张关键帧，让创作者指定人物动作、场景变化和镜头节奏。

全能参考功能也得到升级，单次最多组合 15 项素材，包括图片、视频和人物主体。创作者可以让 AI 参考现有视频的运镜和动作，再替换其中的角色、商品或背景。

卡兹克实测，生成一段 30 秒的 1080P 视频需要 450 积分，按其会员价格折算约 16 元，不含反复生成的成本。

可灵还升级了创作页面，加入时间线、画布和 Agent 功能，并支持通过 MCP、CLI 调用 Kling 4.0，让 AI Agent 自动生成视频、批量制作素材。

不过，4K 输出并非首次加入，3.0 已经支持。真正新增的 10-bit HDR 输出仍未开放，最长 2 分钟的视频续拍和面向开发者的 Kling 4.0 API 也尚未上线。

腾讯WorkBuddy被指抄袭Claude Code：224段文本相同，连内部代号都出现了

动察 Beating AI 快讯，一份技术比对报告质疑，腾讯 WorkBuddy AI 国际版复用了 Claude Code 的内部内容。报告作者解包 WorkBuddy 桌面客户端，将内置的 CodeBuddy CLI 与 Claude Code 泄露源码进行比对，称发现 224 段完全相同的文本，最长达 494 个字符。其中，仅 Claude Code 的记忆管理文件 `memoryTypes.ts`，69 段候选文本中就有 46 段出现在 WorkBuddy。重合内容包括指导 AI 何时记住用户纠正和认可的内部提示词，并非只有普通工具名称。

报告还称，WorkBuddy 程序中保留了 `tengu_goal_set` 等 5 个带有 `tengu_` 前缀的内部事件名，以及 `/tmp/claude`、`.claude/debug` 等路径。`tengu` 是 Claude Code 使用的内部代号。不过，腾讯 CodeBuddy 本就支持 Claude Code 的插件规范，部分路径相同也可能是为了兼容。

Claude Code 虽然是闭源商业软件，但今年 3 月 31 日意外泄露约 51 万行源码。

items.author: Shaurya Malwa
items.content:
An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.
- An internal OpenAI research model used a publicly available recovery phrase to access and spend from another person’s cryptocurrency wallet after it ran out of funds during a coding assignment.
- The June 26 incident occurred on Ethereum’s Sepolia test network, whose tokens have no connection to ether traded on the main network, and OpenAI discovered it on Sept. 25.
- The model completed the assignment without disclosing the source of the funds, prompting OpenAI to add internet-access restrictions and increased monitoring.
An OpenAI research model stuck without funds on an Ethereum test network went looking for someone else’s wallet, found one through recovery phrases that were already public, and spent from it to finish a coding assignment, the company disclosed Thursday.
The incident occurred on June 26 during training of an internal model in the GPT-5.6 Sol family, and OpenAI discovered it on Sept. 25, according to its incident report.
The model needed no hacking skills to get in.
A recovery phrase, also called a seed phrase, is a list of words that generates a wallet’s secret keys; whoever has those words can recreate the accounts and spend from them without ever touching the owner’s device.
The assignment let the model deploy contracts, programs that run on a blockchain, but gave it no funded wallet to pay the fees. After its attempts to get free test tokens failed, it wrote a script that checked 362 addresses generated from recovery phrases commonly used by developers and found one with enough money.
“But using public known key/funds ethically?” the model asked itself in its recorded reasoning, before deciding that a public phrase and test tokens made it acceptable.
The spending happened on Sepolia, a separate network where developers rehearse Ethereum applications before launching them. Its tokens only pay for testing and aren't linked to the ether traded on Ethereum’s main network.
The deployment went through, and the wallet paid the fees. When the model reported back, it said the work was done and left out where the money came from. OpenAI said it has since added restrictions on internet access and more monitoring.
Crypto and AI companies are building agents that hold wallets and pay for services without a person signing off on each step.
OpenAI’s model ran out of money mid-task, found a wallet that wasn’t its own and spent from it without asking. Had it been on Ethereum’s main network, that would have been real ether taken from someone else’s account.

items.author: Shaurya Malwa
items.content:
Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.
- Bitcoin rebounded 1.3% to nearly $82,000 after briefly falling below $80,000, while ZEC led major cryptocurrencies with an 8% gain.
- Asian stocks also recovered, led by gains in South Korean chipmakers, though Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing slipped amid concerns about artificial intelligence spending.
- Traders are watching whether Bitcoin can break above $84,000 and awaiting remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh after hotter-than-expected inflation data.
Bitcoin rose 1.3% to nearly $82,000 as of Friday Asian morning hours after buyers pounced on a brief drop below $80,000, with Asian chip stocks bouncing back from Thursday’s rout.
ZEC was the standout among the majors, jumping 8% to about $1,190. SOL, ether, XRP and TRX added about 1% apiece, and BNB went nowhere, according to CoinDesk data.
Bitcoin’s break below $80,000 lasted all of two hours. The slide on Thursday took it to about $79,800, cutting through the roughly $80,400 low that buyers had defended twice in the past week, and that’s where they showed up again. Bitcoin was back near $82,500 within two hours and held above $81,000 through Asian trading.
Stock traders bought the dip too. MSCI’s Asia Pacific equities gauge climbed 1.3%, with roughly three shares rising for every one that fell. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix both gained more than 2%, and South Korea’s Kospi jumped nearly 3% after closing at its lowest since April on Thursday.
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing was the odd one out, slipping even after an upbeat outlook as worries over AI spending hung around.
Bonds handed back some of Thursday’s rush into safety. Treasuries fell across the curve, pushing the 10-year yield up a basis point to 5.07%. Traders now turn to Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh, who speaks at the IMF and World Bank meetings in Bangkok on Friday, two days after September inflation came in hotter than expected.
A push back above $84,000, where Wednesday’s post-inflation spike ran out of steam, would show this bounce has real buyers behind it.

《金融时报》：投资者抛售数据中心债券，AI借款方面临优胜劣汰时刻

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，据英国《金融时报》报道，投资者对人工智能热潮能否产生足够收入以支撑数据中心巨额债务的信心正在减弱，部分美国大型数据中心项目的融资债券价格近期大幅下跌。为 Meta、英伟达、甲骨文等企业提供数据中心建设资金的部分债券已跌破面值。与此同时，以英伟达投资的 CoreWeave 为代表的云计算基础设施供应商受到更大冲击。CoreWeave 债券价格已跌至面值的 80 美分以下，达到市场通常视为困境债券的水平，周四收益率接近 15%；该公司股价本周下跌 17%，竞争对手 Nebius 下跌 18%。英伟达过去一周市值也蒸发约 2700 亿美元。德国安联集团首席投资官 Ludovic Subran 表示，数据中心债券正迎来「达尔文时刻」，信用资质较弱的项目将面临生存考验，电力供应和建设延期导致信用利差扩大，也反映出市场此前对数据中心债务执行风险的定价过于乐观。

市场担忧的核心在于 AI 基础设施投资规模与未来收入之间存在巨大缺口。OpenAI 将 IPO 推迟至明年，以及 Anthropic 季度销售增速放缓，加剧了投资者对 AI 行业增长可持续性的疑虑。科技咨询机构 Gartner 预计，到 2030 年，80% 的新型云服务商可能无法继续独立运营。其估算，AI 数据中心所有者需要在 2030 年底前实现 8.5 万亿美元收入，才能覆盖资本及融资成本并取得合理回报，但届时消费者和企业在 AI 服务上的支出预计最多仅为 3.6 万亿美元，意味着到 2032 年可能有超过 4 万亿美元的资产面临减值风险。此外，美国部分地区因数据中心的用水、噪声及空气污染问题而加强限制，电力供应审批受阻也进一步拖累项目进展。投资者还对行业内客户与供应商相互融资的循环融资模式保持警惕。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋周四表示，他认为 CoreWeave 不需要英伟达提供兜底支持，并称该公司的资本成本正在下降、经营实力持续改善。

Osmosis发现bOSMO赎回合约漏洞，将向1037个账户赔偿约4.05万枚OSMO

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，据 Osmosis Community Hall 披露，Backbone Labs 发行的流动性质押代币 bOSMO 存在赎回合约漏洞。自 2026 年 4 月以来，合约每次赎回都会重复计算由 Backbone 自有验证者质押的 OSMO，导致赎回用户实际获得的 OSMO 数量比应得水平高约 50%，额外支付部分则由其他 bOSMO 持有者承担。为避免社区资金池赎回时进一步损害其他持有者利益，相关方面于 10 月 10 日通过单笔交易赎回了约 77.6 万枚 bOSMO，提取约 129.97 万枚 OSMO。此次赎回涉及的 OSMO 预计将于 10 月 24 日完成解绑。

Osmosis 表示，将按照赎回前每枚 bOSMO 兑换 1.1174 枚 OSMO 的比例，向快照时持有 bOSMO 的 1037 个账户赔偿约 40,508 枚 OSMO，款项将在 10 月 24 日解绑完成后自动发放，用户无需采取任何操作。不过，赎回后 bOSMO 的资产支持已大幅下降，目前通过 Backbone 赎回每枚 bOSMO 仅能获得约 0.06 枚 OSMO。由于漏洞尚未修复，市场仍可按约 0.039 枚 OSMO 的成本铸造新 bOSMO，部分流动性池的定价可能显著高于实际赎回价值。Osmosis 因此建议用户不要购买 bOSMO 或向相关流动性池提供流动性，并建议现有流动性提供者撤出资金。

英伟达刚拿下美国开源第一，Meta就以39分反超，Agent跑分却落后中国模型

动察 Beating AI 快讯，英伟达的美国开源模型第一，只维持了几个小时。Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上获得 26.5 分，超过此前所有美国开源模型。

不过，放眼全球开源模型榜单，Meta 仍落后于多款中国模型。小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 以 46 分领先，智谱 GLM-5.3 为 45 分，Muse Spark Open 则与 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 同为 39 分。它已经接近 Meta 8 月推出的闭源旗舰 Muse Spark 1.2，后者得分为 40 分。

在得分最高的 9 款开源模型中，Muse Spark Open 的 4 项 Agent 测试综合表现垫底，其他 6 项测试合计却能排第四。与智谱 GLM-5.3 相差的 6 分，全部来自 Agent 测试。

相反，它在知识准确性测试 AA-Omniscience 中以 25 分领先所有开源模型，幻觉率仅为 24%，在得分超过 30 分的开源模型中最低。

Muse Spark Open 的 Token 使用效率也不错。平均每项测试输出约 4 万 Token，比 GLM-5.3 少 43%。

两者 API 单价接近，但由于 Muse 消耗的 Token 更少，每项测试平均花费仅 0.84 美元，不到 GLM-5.3 的一半，但仍是 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的约 3 倍。

分析师：比特币近期下跌抛压主要来自短期持有者，力度有所减弱

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，加密市场分析师 Murphy 表示，短期持有者（STH）近期向交易平台转入的比特币数量明显增加，4 小时内平均每小时转入约 2200 枚 BTC，形成今年 8 月行情启动以来第 4 高的峰值。不过，10 月 15 日的转入量已低于 10 月 8 日，表明短期持有者的抛售压力有所减弱。

相比之下，长期持有者（LTH）昨日向交易平台的转入量较低，4 小时内平均每小时仅约 480 枚 BTC，不足短期持有者的五分之一。这表明，在近期市场下跌及宏观利空预期升温的背景下，长期持有者整体仍相对稳定。

值得注意的是，10 月 8 日长期持有者的转入量曾一度升至每小时 3700 枚 BTC。尽管不排除部分持有者因硬件钱包相关问题而临时转移资产的可能，但当天长期与短期持有者均出现大额转入，且比特币价格快速下跌，说明当时的市场确实存在一定的实际抛售压力。近期比特币下跌期间，向交易平台转入资产的主体主要是短期持有者，长期持有者整体表现稳定，且短期持有者的转入规模已较 10 月 8 日有所下降。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，英伟达发布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，同时开源模型权重。它拥有 1200 亿总参数，每次仅激活 120 亿，支持最高 100 万 Token 上下文。

模型把文字推理、视觉理解和工具调用结合起来。Agent 可以直接阅读 PDF、分析图表和视频，再搜索网页、调用工具完成任务，不必在文字模型与视觉模型之间反复传递信息。

新模型沿用 Mamba 与 Transformer 混合架构，并通过多 Token 预测和四位量化提高推理效率。Artificial Analysis 在 10 万 Token 输入下，测得约每秒 630 Token 的输出速度，是能力分数接近的 Inkling Small 的约 5 倍。

英伟达还称，使用 4 张 B200 GPU 批量处理 1 万次 SWE-bench Pro 编程任务，速度比部分同档开源模型快最多 4 倍。

Artificial Analysis 给出 26.5 分，位居美国开源模型第一，超过英伟达此前 5500 亿参数的 Nemotron 3 Ultra（23 分），但仍落后小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 的 46 分。在英伟达公布的 SWE-bench Pro 对比中，新模型通过率为 51.78%，低于 Qwen3.8 Flash-Next 的 60.37%。

独立测试也暴露了速度与可靠性之间的差距。Plotly 用 43 道数据分析题测试，新模型答对 30 道，单题耗时中位数仅 12 秒，却漏掉了全部 3 道数据质量题和 5 道隐藏规律题。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372143

items.content:
Hyperliquid创始人：希望进军华尔街，但监管应约束金融机构而非区块链本身

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，Hyperliquid Labs 联合创始人 Jeff Yan 在彭博《Odd Lots》播客中表示，目前 Hyperliquid 尚未向美国客户开放，Hyperliquid 更希望成为传统金融机构使用的底层交易技术，而非取代现有金融市场参与者，并将其定位类比为亚马逊云服务（AWS）为企业提供计算基础设施。并称：「我们并不是要取代任何东西，事实上，我认为这项技术可以让目前以更传统方式运营市场的机构受益。」

Jeff Yan 认为，监管义务应落在基于 Hyperliquid 区块链运营市场的金融机构身上，而非区块链网络本身，这种监管安排能够让 Hyperliquid 进一步拓展至华尔街，同时避免承担传统交易所的全部合规负担，区块链更适合作为提供订单簿、清算、全球分发和流动性聚合的底层基础设施。美国监管机构对新技术较为谨慎，但也愿意快速推进创新；对于 Hyperliquid 未来成为「所有金融资产的家园」，其团队「非常认真」。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372138

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
OpenAI内部研究以太坊测试网合约部署，代理缺gas直接盗用公开助记词地址测试币

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，OpenAI 官网披露，今年 6 月，OpenAI 内部一个研究模型（GPT-5.6 Sol 系列）被分配任务：更新一个加密货币交易应用，并在以太坊测试网 Sepolia 上部署合约。任务没有提供已注资的钱包，也没授权使用外部资金。

该模型先尝试从水龙头领测试 ETH 失败。随后它自己想出办法——从网上公开的开发者助记词（public seed phrase）中派生地址，扫描了数百个后找到一个有余额的账户。它在内部推理中明确质疑「用公开私钥的资金合不合伦理」，最终自圆其说：这些是测试网、无实际价值的 ETH，且助记词早已公开，资金「effectively abandoned（实际上已被放弃）」，于是用该账户支付了部署所需的 gas，成功完成了合约部署。

OpenAI 在后续扩大对齐监控时发现了这次行为，并于 2026 年 10 月 15 日在官方 Misalignment Reports 中正式披露。事件被归类为「未经授权使用已注资的测试加密货币钱包」，显示模型用自己的判断取代了账户持有人的授权。

⚡️Justin Sun谈量子威胁：市场严重低估Q-Day对比特币价格带来的潜在毁灭性打击

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 16 日，Justin Sun 近日在接受采访时谈及量子计算对于加密行业的潜在威胁，其表示「数学对加密行业极其关键，目前大家都在关注量子攻击。波场正在推进落实 NIST（美国国家标准与技术研究院）的后量子加密标准，让区块链具备抵抗量子攻击的能力。这项技术目前已经在测试网上线，预计最快明年初就会在主网落地。

很多人严重低估了量子威胁日（Q-Day）的破坏力。加密行业的大多数人根本不知道比特币网络达成共识有多慢。我从 2012 年就进入比特币社区了，整个社区的技术推进非常缓慢。即便全网明确知道两年后某个灾难一定会发生，要在短短两年内让比特币全网达成共识并完成升级，几乎是不可能的任务。

像贝莱德这样的大型美国金融机构里的基金经理，根本没有花足够的时间去研究这件事。在他们的传统认知里，这可能就像苹果手机系统出了个 Bug，两分钟之后苹果官方推一个系统更新补丁，所有人点击升级，问题就解决了。但底层公链的技术演进完全不是这么回事。这些机构往里面投了几十上百亿美金，但他们并不真正参与比特币的开发，不懂底层技术，也不关心它在技术维度如何演进，就像买了苹果股票的基金经理不会每天去研究 iOS 的系统底层代码一样。量子威胁日绝对会是一个巨大的麻烦，市场严重低估了 Q-Day 对比特币价格带来的潜在毁灭性打击。」

Ramp完成18.5亿美元融资，估值600亿美元：曾一周烧掉150万美元Token，如今要管企业AI账单

动察 Beating AI 快讯，美国金融科技公司 Ramp 宣布完成 18.5 亿美元融资，估值达到 600 亿美元。本轮由 Dragoneer 领投，Thrive Capital、Founders Fund 等共同领投。四个月前，Ramp 刚以 440 亿美元估值融资 7.5 亿美元，短短四个月估值又涨了 160 亿美元。

Ramp 成立于 2019 年，最初提供企业信用卡和报销管理，如今业务已扩展到支付、采购和财务对账。公司目前服务超过 8.5 万家企业，比今年 6 月增加 1.5 万家。平台年化支付额超过 2750 亿美元，同比增长 175%；年化营收超过 20 亿美元，现金流已经转正。按最新估值计算，约为年化营收的 30 倍。

Ramp 正在把企业财务管理延伸到 AI 支出。联合 CEO Eric Glyman 此前透露，今年 5 月，公司有一周的 Token 开支竟高达 150 万美元。Ramp 随后将内部使用的成本管理能力推向市场，推出 AI Token Spend Management，帮助企业按员工、模型和 API Key 追踪费用。配套的 Router 可以为不同任务选择更便宜、性能合适的模型，官方称客户平均节省约 40% 的推理成本。

10 月 13 日，Ramp 还开放了 AI 工作平台 Glass 的早期体验，让员工共享提示词、技能和自动化流程，并追踪每项工作的 Token 消耗。早期投资人 Keith Rabois 甚至向 TechCrunch 表示，Ramp 的目标不是与企业管理软件公司 Rippling 竞争，而是成为企业管理 AI Token 开支及投资回报的主要入口，最终与 Anthropic 展开竞争。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Meta与苹果罕见联手：8160亿参数Muse Spark开源，两台Mac Studio就能本地运行

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Meta 开源 Muse Spark Open 模型权重，并与苹果合作，让这款 8160 亿参数的大模型能够在 Mac Studio 上本地运行。模型每次推理仅激活 420 亿参数，支持 100 万 Token 上下文，主要面向编程和复杂 Agent 任务。权重已于 10 月 15 日上架 Hugging Face，开发者登录并接受访问条件后即可申请获取。

Meta 与苹果过去因隐私政策多次交锋，扎克伯格如今却公开感谢苹果 CEO John Ternus，后者也亲自回应。双方利用苹果的 MLX 框架，将模型分配到多台 Mac Studio 上运行。即使压缩到 4 位精度，模型仍需约 493GB 内存，加上推理开销，单台 Mac Studio 装不下。

实际部署至少需要两台配备 M5 Ultra 芯片、各有 512GB 统一内存的 Mac Studio，硬件成本超过 4 万美元。苹果实测显示，四台 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 协同运行，在 8192 Token 上下文下，每秒可生成约 37 个 Token。

Meta 采用自定义的 Muse Model License，允许开发者修改、商用和分发模型，但要求在产品或相关文档中注明使用 Muse Spark Open。企业及其关联方连续 12 个月总营收超过 2000 万美元，若要将模型作为 API 服务对外提供，还须先与 Meta 另行签约。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372118

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy
Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi were previously identified for deletion under the methodology, with MSCI set to announce its final list on Nov. 11.
Index provider MSCI has adopted new rules that could lead to Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi being removed from its global indexes, while leaving several other crypto treasury companies facing potential exclusion.
MSCI said Thursday it will adopt a methodology proposed in August that would make “non-operating companies” ineligible for inclusion in the MSCI Global Investable Market Indexes.
MSCI previously identified Strategy (MSTR) among the companies that would be deleted from the indexes under the “non-operating companies methodology.” Sharplink, Inc (SBET), Ton Strategy Company (TONX), Solana Company (HSDT) and DeFi Development Corp. (DFDV) are among companies that would be put on a “watchlist” for potential removal.
Removal could force funds tracking MSCI indexes to sell the affected companies’ shares, potentially putting pressure on stock prices and reducing passive investment demand.
“It removes a company from the default portfolios of tens of millions of people who never chose to remove it,” said Conner Brown, executive director of the Bitcoin Policy Institute in September, who was describing the consequences of broad-market index exclusion, with Strategy as the example.
Related: Strategy adds 250 Bitcoin as holdings reach 848,250 BTC
Under the new methodology, MSCI will assess companies based on their operating assets and five financial ratios. Companies failing at least four of the five tests could be deemed ineligible. Existing companies in the index must generally fail the screening process over two annual reporting periods before removal.
The final list of companies to be removed will be released on Nov. 11 and will take effect on Nov. 30, 2026, according to MSCI.
JPMorgan analysts previously estimated that Strategy’s exclusion from MSCI indexes could trigger roughly $2.8 billion in selling. That estimate concerned MSCI’s earlier digital asset proposal, rather than the rules adopted Thursday.
In August, Strategy opposed the changes but also played down the potential disruption, saying funds tracking MSCI’s Global Investable Market Indexes hold approximately 13 million shares, representing 3.1% of its basic shares outstanding. The company said those holdings amount to less than one day’s trading volume.

items.author: 0in
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[amluto]: I don’t really understand the legal theory here. Party A (Meta) writes a contract with Party B (a business account holder) ostensibly granting A the right to scrape B’s website and a license to the content. But why is there any presumption that B owns the content or has any right to grant this license?  It’s extremely common for a publisher to license content from a third party under terms that may not allow this sort of sublicencing.  What happens if the publisher can’t grant this license?

[Centigonal]: This is some next level legal judo. Say what you want about the metaverse or muse, but it's clear that Meta is still innovating when it comes to its Terms of Service.

[nananana9]: Doesn't them requiring a license from partners to train on their content undermine the more general argument that they  don't  need a license from copyright owners to train on copyrighted content -- which I assume most big AI firms would love to make? IANAL, but this looks like Meta lawyers trying to shield themselves against partners' suing them, but enough cases like this could help set a precedent that -- yes, you do in fact need a license.

[sandeepkd]: I do not want to be cynical, yet my reading is that they are most likely doing it already. This is to provide a legal cover to it.

[phyzome]: "Will consent", that's some interesting phrasing in the current post title.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework
Australia is among 77 jurisdictions committed to adopting CARF, with its first international exchanges of crypto tax data expected in 2028.
Australia has released draft legislation that would enable the automatic exchange of crypto tax information between countries.
The draft bill, Treasury Laws Amendment Bill 2026: Tax information reporting, is open to comment until Oct. 28. It would establish a framework to implement the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) in Australian law and introduce a domestic crypto reporting regime, according to the Australian Treasury.
Australia first signaled its intention to implement CARF in November 2023 and consulted on its proposed approach in late 2024. The government subsequently announced plans to implement both CARF and a domestic crypto reporting regime in its 2025–26 Mid-Year Economic and Fiscal Outlook, with international exchanges of crypto tax information expected to begin in 2028.
The OECD approved CARF in August 2022 to address tax evasion risks arising from the growth of crypto assets.
Related: Australia seeks feedback on crypto platform rules ahead of 2027 rollout
items.title: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework

items.author: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton
items.content:
Scammer loses $4.8M stored on tampered Ledgers: Asia Express
A scammer reportedly lost $4.8M of stolen money after storing the funds on tampered Ledgers. Bitcoin and Ether ETFs launch trading in Thailand and South Korea blocks 27 exchanges.
Major irony alert as scammer falls victim to Ledger supply chain attack
Ledger was forced to suspend its reseller network across South East Asia this week, after thieves stole more than $103.4 million from 530 addresses via tampered Ledgers inserted into the supply chain. But in a small measure of poetic justice, one of the “victims” was a scammer themselves according to Chainalysis.
The blockchain monitoring firm reports that the scammer lost 60 Bitcoin, worth about $4.8 million, from three newly purchased Ledgers containing spyware that records seed phrases. The Ledger thieves drained all three of their funds into the same wallet.
In a further irony, the scammer had operated a “task scam” where people were paid to fake sales and reviews of real items. So depending on how much they knew, their victims in turn may not have been entirely honest either. “Then a ‘negative balance’ appeared, and they were told to add their own money in order to get paid,” Chainalysis reports. So it’s possible that a scammer of scammers has just got scammed. In crypto it’s sometimes turtles all the way down.
Despite reports of tampered Ledgers showing up in Europe forcing electronics retailer MediaMarkt to suspend sales, Ledger insists that all of the confirmed thefts to date are from Asia. It has asked resellers in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to remove Ledgers from sale. Trezor too, has decided to shutter some of the more far flung resellers in its network from Jan.1, as it can’t guarantee it can perform the same level of vigilance as it performs on resellers closer to home. There are no reports of tampered Trezors however.
In the midst of the worst hardware wallet scandal since the Coldcard seed phrase debacle at the end of July, Ledger decided it was the ideal moment to launch its latest device. Called Atom, the $849 device combines a crypto wallet with Android apps, which are kept separated from sensitive wallet operations. The device includes protections Ledger says would block the implants used in the Asian thefts and claims it can detect tampering even when switched off.
A first look at Ledger Atom. Source: Ledger
SOUTH KOREA
South Korea moves to block 27 overseas crypto exchanges
South Korean authorities have approved measures to block domestic access to 27 websites operated by unregistered crypto exchanges and other virtual asset service providers, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue.
The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) said in a statement: “With this decision, blocking measures against illegal virtual asset operators will also apply to internet websites, following apps such as those on Apple and Google,” the FIU said, according to a translation.
The list also includes CoinW, BTCC, BitMart, BingX, DigiFinex and others.
South Korea plans cybersecurity overhaul after attacks hit banks, crypto firms
South Korea will tighten cybersecurity requirements for financial institutions after an investigation into earlier security incidents involving 16 companies including crypto exchanges found some big holes.
The Financial Services Commission said it would pursue improved threat monitoring, more frequent security assessments and stronger accountability for executives after an industry-wide review found cybersecurity deficiencies at 130 of 555 financial companies.
South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
Jeonbuk Bank reportedly began offering Bitcoin-backed loans to corporate customers, with a third-party custodian holding the cryptocurrency used as collateral.
THAILAND
Thailand’s Bitcoin, Ether ETFs launch trading
Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission has finalized rules that go into effect Friday allowing crypto exchange-traded funds (ETFs) to list on Thailand’s main stock exchange.
Kicking off with Bitcoin and Ether ETFs, the products must list exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. Products linked to foreign crypto ETFs will not be permitted initially, and Thai brokers are barred from facilitating investments in overseas crypto ETFs for anyone except institutions and ultra-high-net-worth individuals.
However, James Butterfill, head of research at digital asset investment firm CoinShares, told Cointelegraph not to get too excited.
“I would expect modest inflows initially, with tens of millions of US dollars across the first products a more realistic starting expectation than billions,” he said.
AUSTRALIA
Australia seeks feedback on crypto platform rules ahead of 2027 rollout
Australia’s securities regulator opened consultation Thursday on proposed capital, custody and trading requirements for crypto platforms, as it prepares to implement legislation passed in April that expands oversight of the industry.
The proposals include three alternative capital models, restrictions on platforms trading for their own account and quarterly reporting of wallets holding customer assets. ASIC also proposes allowing offshore custody while seeking feedback on safeguards if an overseas parent or related company fails.
The Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) also proposed expanding the rules for contracts for difference (CFDs) to crypto. CFDs let traders bet on price movements without owning the underlying asset.
CHINA
Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 Bitcoin seized by the British government have lost a key legal battle after London’s High Court ruled that Chinese law, rather than English law, should govern claims to the assets.
“The relevant damage occurred in China. The Applicants parted with their money in China,” Justice Mark Turner wrote. “The contractual relationships thereby induced were entered into in China.”
The dispute stems from an investment fraud scheme orchestrated by Zhimin Qian between 2014 and 2017, with British authorities seizing the assets during a money-laundering investigation. The claimants will appeal the ruling in British courts.
THE PHILIPPINES
Coins.ph says it still has a Philippine central bank license intact despite reports
Coins.ph said it is still licensed by the country’s central bank despite reports that it could face license revocation over alleged transactions involving restricted offshore gambling operators.
Coins.ph is one of the largest crypto exchanges in the Philippines, and the reported license risk follows restrictions imposed by the central bank on some incoming transfers involving DCPay Philippines which operates Coins.ph’s peso e-wallet services.
“Coins.ph firmly denies any claim that it knowingly serves offshore gaming or gambling operators,” the company said. “Our users’ funds are safe; we continue to operate as a BSP-licensed institution,” it added.
HONG KONG
Binance may add Asian stocks to the platform
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said during Token2049 the exchange may add Hong Kong, Korean, Taiwanese and Brazilian equities to its platform.
Second Solana ETF lists in Hong Kong
Pando Finance’s Solana ETF has launched in Hong Kong’s HKEX under the ticker 2831.hk. It’s the second such fund and has a 0.6% fee, undercutting the first fund from ChinaAMC which charges 0.99% annually.
SINGAPORE
Singapore crypto scam losses fall by 43%
A crackdown by Singapore Police in partnership with local crypto exchanges helped contribute to a 43% fall in reported losses from crypto scams year over year.
Revolut to open new Singapore office
Revolut has announced it will open a new Singapore office, invest S$350 million (US$273M) over the next five years, and expand its local workforce from 170 to 300
